# Author the minimal pod skill and Anth.us doctrine

## Purpose

Give agents enough context to follow the newsroom discipline without turning doctrine into an uncapped second product.

## Deliverables

- One pod-specific skill that directs agents to inspect and advance work through Kanbus.
- Minimal Anth.us publication doctrine that can be read in full on every run.
- Clear separation between internal research/reporting and publishable copy.
- Explicit process-versus-authority language: the pod enforces transitions, not verified identity.
- Explicit instruction that pod-generated CMS files are outputs and must not be edited directly.
- Guidance for revision, blocked transitions, and escalation to the editor.

## Verification

A fresh agent session can inspect a story, locate the complete doctrine, identify the next supported action, and explain the pod/hosted boundary without relying on prior chat context.
